Name: Hushim, Wife of Shaharaim
Summary: Wife of Shaharaim, by whom he begat Abitub and Elpaal.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:8: Wife of Shaharaim, by whom he begat Abitub and Elpaal.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hushim in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
